items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Can you sing them like Sister Kay? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: When you were young, what music do you remember? Music or singing? Very early.
Well, the first, one of the first pieces I learned to play on the violin. Can you sing them like Sister Kay? I never forget that song.
